evals.prompt: Audit and fix this existing responsive interface: the navbar wraps at intermediate widths, cards become too narrow, and a sticky CTA overlaps content on mobile. Preserve the design system and validate the critical viewport matrix.
expectations: Uses content-driven composition changes instead of hiding overflow
Reports every required viewport as validated, revalidated, or not tested

evals.prompt: Make this product page robust at phone, tablet, desktop, 150% zoom, translated copy that is 30% longer, and slow or missing media without changing the visual identity.
expectations: Checks long content, zoom, media ratios, and dynamic states
Prefers fluid sizing and structural fixes over fixed heights or truncation
Distinguishes automated checks from visual inspection

evals.prompt: Invent a completely new visual identity and art direction for a greenfield landing page.
expectations: Does not claim ownership of greenfield art direction
Hands primary visual direction work to frontend-aesthetics
